item.title: Dear Abby: Dad’s $$ favor repaid with lies, abuse
item.description: "Marie," borrowed a large sum of money and agreed to repay it in installments. She paid me back a portion of the money. When the next installment was due, she claimed her first payment was three times more than it had been.
